newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Halla to invest in China bus service JV.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Halla to invest in China bus service JV.

text.p: Halla Merchant Marine, a subsidiary of South Korea's Halla Group, will invest $8.0 million in an express bus service joint venture in China next year, a Halla Group statement said on Monday.
The statement said Halla Merchant will team up with Shijiazhung Transportation Co and Baoding Transportation Co to provide service to several Chinese cities, including Beijing.
The $16-million transporation project will begin service in March, it said. The remaining $8.0 million will come from the two Chinese partners.

Halla said it plans to build terminals, restaurants, shopping and lodging facilities for the project, and gradually expand the service routes. It will also seek to manufacture auto parts and assemble express buses in Hebei Province.
